sanskrit: sa gatvā sāgaraṃ rājā gaṅgayānugatas tadā praviveśa talaṃ bhūmer yatra te bhasmasātkṛtāḥ
english: That king, accompanied by Gaṅgā, went to the ocean and descended to the floor of the earth where those sons had been reduced to ashes.

sanskrit: bhasmany athāplute rāma gaṅgāyāḥ salilena vai sarva lokaprabhur brahmā rājānam idam abravīt
english: When the ashes had been bathed in Gaṅgā's waters, O Rāma, Brahmā, lord of all the worlds, spoke these words to the king.

sanskrit: tāritā naraśārdūla divaṃ yātāś ca devavat ṣaṣṭiḥ putrasahasrāṇi sagarasya mahātmanaḥ
english: "O tiger among men, the sixty thousand sons of the great-souled Sagara have been ferried across and have gone to heaven like gods."

sanskrit: sāgarasya jalaṃ loke yāvat sthāsyati pārthiva sagarasyātmajās tāvat svarge sthāsyanti devavat
english: "For as long as the waters of the ocean remain in this world, O king, the sons of Sagara shall dwell in heaven like gods."

sanskrit: iyaṃ ca duhitā jyeṣṭhā tava gaṅgā bhaviṣyati tvatkṛtena ca nāmnā vai loke sthāsyati viśrutā
english: "And this Gaṅgā shall be your eldest daughter; by the name you have bestowed she shall be renowned throughout the world."

sanskrit: gaṅgā tripathagā nāma divyā bhāgīrathīti ca tripatho bhāvayantīti tatas tripathagā smṛtā
english: "The divine Gaṅgā is called Tripathagā — she who moves by three paths — and Bhāgīrathī; because she sustains the three paths, she is thus remembered as Tripathagā."

sanskrit: pitāmahānāṃ sarveṣāṃ tvam atra manujādhipa kuruṣva salilaṃ rājan pratijñām apavarjaya
english: "Perform the water-offering here for all your forebears, O lord of men; fulfill your vow, O king."

sanskrit: pūrvakeṇa hi te rājaṃs tenātiyaśasā tadā dharmiṇāṃ pravareṇātha naiṣa prāpto manorathaḥ
english: "Your forefather of surpassing glory, the foremost among the righteous, did not attain this cherished wish."

sanskrit: tathaivāṃśumatā tāta loke 'pratimatejasā gaṅgāṃ prārthayatā netuṃ pratijñā nāpavarjitā
english: "Likewise Aṃśumat, O dear one, of matchless splendor in the world, who sought to bring Gaṅgā, was unable to fulfill his vow."

sanskrit: rājarṣiṇā guṇavatā maharṣisamatejasā mattulyatapasā caiva kṣatradharmasthitena ca
english: "The royal sage endowed with virtues, of splendor equal to a great ṛṣi, of austerity equal to mine, and steadfast in the dharma of the kṣatriya —"

sanskrit: dilīpena mahābhāga tava pitrātitejasā punar na śaṅkitā netuṃ gaṅgāṃ prārthayatānagha
english: "— Dilīpa, O greatly fortunate one, your father of surpassing brilliance, who desired to bring Gaṅgā, also could not achieve it, O sinless one."

sanskrit: sā tvayā samatikrāntā pratijñā puruṣarṣabha prāpto 'si paramaṃ loke yaśaḥ paramasaṃmatam
english: "That vow has been fulfilled by you, O bull among men; you have attained the highest fame in the world, held in supreme esteem."

sanskrit: yac ca gaṅgāvataraṇaṃ tvayā kṛtam ariṃdama anena ca bhavān prāpto dharmasyāyatanaṃ mahat
english: "And by this descent of Gaṅgā that you have accomplished, O subduer of foes, you have attained a great abode of dharma."

sanskrit: plāvayasva tvam ātmānaṃ narottama sadocite salile puruṣavyāghra śuciḥ puṇyaphalo bhava
english: "Bathe yourself in these auspicious waters, O best of men, O tiger among men; become purified and reap the fruit of merit."

sanskrit: pitāmahānāṃ sarveṣāṃ kuruṣva salilakriyām svasti te 'stu gamiṣyāmi svaṃ lokaṃ gamyatāṃ nṛpa
english: "Perform the water-rite for all your forebears. May you fare well; I shall depart to my own realm — let the king also go."

sanskrit: ity evam uktvā deveśaḥ sarvalokapitāmahaḥ yathāgataṃ tathāgacchad devalokaṃ mahāyaśāḥ
english: Having spoken thus, the lord of the gods, the grandsire of all worlds, of great glory, departed to the divine realm by the way he had come.

sanskrit: bhagīratho 'pi rājarṣiḥ kṛtvā salilam uttamam yathākramaṃ yathānyāyaṃ sāgarāṇāṃ mahāyaśāḥ kṛtodakaḥ śucī rājā svapuraṃ praviveśa ha
english: The royal sage Bhagīratha too, of great glory, having performed the highest water-rites for the Sāgaras in proper order and due form, the king — his rites completed and purified — entered his own city.

sanskrit: samṛddhārtho naraśreṣṭha svarājyaṃ praśaśāsa ha pramumoda ca lokas taṃ nṛpam āsādya rāghava naṣṭaśokaḥ samṛddhārtho babhūva vigatajvaraḥ
english: His purpose fulfilled, O best of men, he ruled his kingdom; and the people rejoiced on receiving that king, O Rāghava, — free from grief, their purposes fulfilled, rid of affliction.

sanskrit: eṣa te rāma gaṅgāyā vistaro 'bhihito mayā svasti prāpnuhi bhadraṃ te saṃdhyākālo 'tivartate
english: This account of Gaṅgā in full has been told to you by me, O Rāma. May you prosper; may all be well with you. The hour of twilight is passing.

sanskrit: dhanyaṃ yaśasyam āyuṣyaṃ svargyaṃ putryam athāpi ca idam ākhyānam ākhyātaṃ gaṅgāvataraṇaṃ mayā
english: Meritorious, fame-bestowing, life-prolonging, heavenly, and conducive to offspring — such is this tale of the descent of Gaṅgā that I have narrated.

sanskrit: viśvāmitravacaḥ śrutvā rāghavaḥ sahalakṣmaṇaḥ vismayaṃ paramaṃ gatvā viśvāmitram athābravīt
english: Having heard the words of Viśvāmitra, Rāghava together with Lakṣmaṇa was filled with the greatest wonder and spoke to Viśvāmitra.

sanskrit: atyadbhutam idaṃ brahman kathitaṃ paramaṃ tvayā gaṅgāvataraṇaṃ puṇyaṃ sāgarasya ca pūraṇam
english: "This is utterly wondrous, O brahman — this supreme account narrated by you: the auspicious descent of Gaṅgā and the filling of the ocean."

sanskrit: tasya sā śarvarī sarvā saha saumitriṇā tadā jagāma cintayānasya viśvāmitrakathāṃ śubhām
english: That entire night passed for him — together with Saumitri — as he pondered the auspicious tale of Viśvāmitra.

sanskrit: tataḥ prabhāte vimale viśvāmitraṃ mahāmunim uvāca rāghavo vākyaṃ kṛtāhnikam ariṃdamaḥ
english: Then at the clear dawn, Rāghava, the subduer of foes, having performed his morning rites, spoke these words to the great sage Viśvāmitra.

sanskrit: gatā bhagavatī rātriḥ śrotavyaṃ paramaṃ śrutam kṣaṇabhūteva sā rātriḥ saṃvṛtteyaṃ mahātapaḥ imāṃ cintayataḥ sarvāṃ nikhilena kathāṃ tava
english: "The blessed night has passed; what was most worthy of hearing has been heard. That night passed as if it were but a moment, O great ascetic, for me as I pondered your entire tale from beginning to end."

sanskrit: tarāma saritāṃ śreṣṭhāṃ puṇyāṃ tripathagāṃ nadīm naur eṣā hi sukhāstīrṇā ṛṣīṇāṃ puṇyakarmaṇām bhagavantam iha prāptaṃ jñātvā tvaritam āgatā
english: "Let us cross the foremost of rivers, the holy Tripathagā stream; this boat, comfortably spread out, belonging to the ṛṣis of meritorious deeds, has come here quickly knowing that the reverend one has arrived."

sanskrit: tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā rāghavasya mahātmanaḥ saṃtāraṃ kārayām āsa sarṣisaṃghaḥ sarāghavaḥ
english: Having heard those words of the great-souled Rāghava, the sage together with the assembly of ṛṣis caused them all — with Rāghava — to be ferried across.

sanskrit: uttaraṃ tīram āsādya saṃpūjyarṣigaṇaṃ tatha gaṅgākūle niviṣṭās te viśālāṃ dadṛśuḥ purīm
english: Having reached the northern bank and duly honored the company of ṛṣis, they encamped on the bank of the Gaṅgā and beheld the city of Viśālā.

sanskrit: tato munivaras tūrṇaṃ jagāma saharāghavaḥ viśālāṃ nagarīṃ ramyāṃ divyāṃ svargopamāṃ tadā
english: Then the chief of sages quickly proceeded with Rāghava to the charming city of Viśālā, divine, resembling heaven.

sanskrit: atha rāmo mahāprājño viśvāmitraṃ mahāmunim papraccha prāñjalir bhūtvā viśālām uttamāṃ purīm
english: Then Rāma of great wisdom, with joined palms, asked the great sage Viśvāmitra about that excellent city of Viśālā.

sanskrit: kataro rājavaṃśo 'yaṃ viśālāyāṃ mahāmune śrotum icchāmi bhadraṃ te paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me
english: "What is this royal lineage in Viśālā, O great sage? I wish to hear; may all be well with you — I have the greatest curiosity."

sanskrit: tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā rāmasya munipuṃgavaḥ ākhyātuṃ tat samārebhe viśālasya purātanam
english: Having heard those words of Rāma, the bull among sages began to recount the ancient [history] of Viśālā.

sanskrit: śrūyatāṃ rāma śakrasya kathāṃ kathayataḥ śubhām asmin deśe hi yad vṛttaṃ śṛṇu tattvena rāghava
english: "Hear, O Rāma, this auspicious tale as I tell it of Śakra. What transpired in this region — hear it in truth, O Rāghava."

sanskrit: pūrvaṃ kṛtayuge rāma diteḥ putrā mahābalāḥ aditeś ca mahābhāgā vīryavantaḥ sudhārmikāḥ
english: "In the Kṛta age of old, O Rāma, the sons of Diti were of great strength, and the sons of Aditi were of great fortune, possessed of valor, and supremely righteous."

sanskrit: tatas teṣāṃ naraśreṣṭha buddhir āsīn mahātmanām amarā nirjarāś caiva kathaṃ syāma nirāmayāḥ
english: "Then a thought arose among those great-souled ones, O best of men: 'How may we become immortal, free from aging and free from disease?'"

sanskrit: teṣāṃ cintayatāṃ rāma buddhir āsīd vipaścitām kṣīrodamathanaṃ kṛtvā rasaṃ prāpsyāma tatra vai
english: "As those wise ones deliberated, O Rāma, a thought arose among them: 'By churning the ocean of milk, we shall obtain the nectar therein.'"

sanskrit: tato niścitya mathanaṃ yoktraṃ kṛtvā ca vāsukim manthānaṃ mandaraṃ kṛtvā mamanthur amitaujasaḥ
english: "Having resolved to churn, using Vāsuki as the churning rope and Mount Mandara as the churning staff, those of boundless might churned."

sanskrit: atha dhanvantarir nāma apsarāś ca suvarcasaḥ apsu nirmathanād eva rasāt tasmād varastriyaḥ utpetur manujaśreṣṭha tasmād apsaraso 'bhavan
english: "Then one named Dhanvantari arose, and also the radiant Apsarases — from that churning of the waters, from that nectar, O best of men, those excellent women arose; hence they came to be called Apsarases."

sanskrit: ṣaṣṭiḥ koṭyo 'bhavaṃs tāsām apsarāṇāṃ suvarcasām asaṃkhyeyās tu kākutstha yās tāsāṃ paricārikāḥ
english: "There were sixty crores of those radiant Apsarases, O Kākutstha, and their attendants were beyond counting."

sanskrit: na tāḥ sma pratigṛhṇanti sarve te devadānavāḥ apratigrahaṇāc caiva tena sādhāraṇāḥ smṛtāḥ
english: "None of the gods or dānavas accepted them; and because none accepted them, they are remembered as 'common to all' (sādhāraṇāḥ)."

sanskrit: varuṇasya tataḥ kanyā vāruṇī raghunandana utpapāta mahābhāgā mārgamāṇā parigraham
english: "Then the daughter of Varuṇa, Vāruṇī of great fortune, O delight of the Raghu line, arose seeking someone to accept her."

sanskrit: diteḥ putrā na tāṃ rāma jagṛhur varuṇātmajām adites tu sutā vīra jagṛhus tām aninditām
english: "The sons of Diti, O Rāma, did not accept that daughter of Varuṇa; but the sons of Aditi, O hero, accepted that blameless one."

sanskrit: asurās tena daiteyāḥ surās tenāditeḥ sutāḥ hṛṣṭāḥ pramuditāś cāsan vāruṇī grahaṇāt surāḥ
english: "Thus the sons of Diti became asuras, and the sons of Aditi became suras; the suras were joyful and delighted at the acceptance of Vāruṇī."

sanskrit: uccaiḥśravā hayaśreṣṭho maṇiratnaṃ ca kaustubham udatiṣṭhan naraśreṣṭha tathaivāmṛtam uttamam
english: "Uccaiḥśravā the chief of horses, the jewel-gem Kaustubha, and likewise the supreme amṛta arose, O best of men."

sanskrit: atha tasya kṛte rāma mahān āsīt kulakṣayaḥ adites tu tataḥ putrā diteḥ putrāṇa sūdayan
english: "Then, O Rāma, on account of this there was a great destruction of clans; the sons of Aditi thereafter slew the sons of Diti."

sanskrit: aditer ātmajā vīrā diteḥ putrān nijaghnire tasmin ghore mahāyuddhe daiteyādityayor bhṛśam
english: "The heroic sons of Aditi slaughtered the sons of Diti in that terrible great battle between the Daiteyas and the Ādityas, which was exceedingly fierce."

sanskrit: nihatya ditiputrāṃs tu rājyaṃ prāpya puraṃdaraḥ śaśāsa mudito lokān sarṣisaṃghān sacāraṇān
english: "Having slain the sons of Diti and obtained the kingdom, Purandara joyfully ruled the worlds together with the assemblies of ṛṣis and Cāraṇas."

sanskrit: hateṣu teṣu putreṣu ditiḥ paramaduḥkhitā mārīcaṃ kāśyapaṃ rāma bhartāram idam abravīt
english: When those sons had been slain, Diti, overcome with the deepest grief, spoke these words to her husband, Mārīca Kāśyapa, O Rāma.

sanskrit: hataputrāsmi bhagavaṃs tava putrair mahābalaiḥ śakrahantāram icchāmi putraṃ dīrghatapo'rjitam
english: "My sons have been slain, O reverend one, by your great and mighty sons. I desire a son who will slay Śakra — a son won by long austerity."

sanskrit: sāhaṃ tapaś cariṣyāmi garbhaṃ me dātum arhasi īdṛśaṃ śakrahantāraṃ tvam anujñātum arhasi
english: "I shall perform austerities; you must grant me an embryo; grant your permission for one such as this — a slayer of Śakra."

sanskrit: tasyās tad vacanaṃ śrutvā mārīcaḥ kāśyapas tadā pratyuvāca mahātejā ditiṃ paramaduḥkhitām
english: Having heard her words, the greatly resplendent Mārīca Kāśyapa then replied to Diti, who was overcome with the deepest grief.

sanskrit: evaṃ bhavatu bhadraṃ te śucir bhava tapodhane janayiṣyasi putraṃ tvaṃ śakra hantāram āhave
english: "So be it — may all be well with you, O one rich in austerity. Be pure; you shall bring forth a son who will be Śakra's slayer in battle."

sanskrit: pūrṇe varṣasahasre tu śucir yadi bhaviṣyasi putraṃ trailokya hantāraṃ mattas tvaṃ janayiṣyasi
english: "But if you remain pure throughout the full thousand years, you shall beget from me a son who will be the destroyer of the three worlds."

sanskrit: evam uktvā mahātejāḥ pāṇinā sa mamārja tām samālabhya tataḥ svastīty uktvā sa tapase yayau
english: Having spoken thus, the greatly resplendent one stroked her with his hand; and having thus touched her and said "fare well," he departed for austerities.

sanskrit: gate tasmin naraśreṣṭha ditiḥ paramaharṣitā kuśaplavanam āsādya tapas tepe sudāruṇam
english: When he had departed, O best of men, Diti was overwhelmed with joy; reaching the grove of Kuśaplava, she performed the most severe austerities.

sanskrit: tapas tasyāṃ hi kurvatyāṃ paricaryāṃ cakāra ha sahasrākṣo naraśreṣṭha parayā guṇasaṃpadā
english: While she was performing those austerities, O best of men, the thousand-eyed one attended upon her with the greatest excellence of virtuous service.

sanskrit: agniṃ kuśān kāṣṭham apaḥ phalaṃ mūlaṃ tathaiva ca nyavedayat sahasrākṣo yac cānyad api kāṅkṣitam
english: The thousand-eyed one presented her with fire, kuśa grass, firewood, water, fruits, and roots, and likewise whatever else was desired.

sanskrit: gātrasaṃvāhanaiś caiva śramāpanayanais tathā śakraḥ sarveṣu kāleṣu ditiṃ paricacāra ha
english: With massages of her limbs and the removal of her fatigue, Śakra attended upon Diti at all times.

sanskrit: atha varṣasahasretu daśone raghu nandana ditiḥ paramasaṃprītā sahasrākṣam athābravīt
english: Then, when ten years remained of the thousand, O delight of the Raghu line, Diti, filled with the utmost joy, spoke to the thousand-eyed one.

sanskrit: tapaś carantyā varṣāṇi daśa vīryavatāṃ vara avaśiṣṭāni bhadraṃ te bhrātaraṃ drakṣyase tataḥ
english: "Ten years remain as I perform austerities, O best of the mighty; then, may it be well with you, you shall see a brother."

sanskrit: tam ahaṃ tvatkṛte putra samādhāsye jayotsukam trailokyavijayaṃ putra saha bhokṣyasi vijvaraḥ
english: "Him, O son, I shall set to the task of conquest for your sake; you shall enjoy, O son, the conquest of the three worlds together, free from affliction."

sanskrit: evam uktvā ditiḥ śakraṃ prāpte madhyaṃ divākare nidrayāpahṛtā devī pādau kṛtvātha śīrṣataḥ
english: Having spoken thus to Śakra, when midday had come, the goddess Diti was overcome by sleep, having placed her feet where her head should be.

sanskrit: dṛṣṭvā tām aśuciṃ śakraḥ pādataḥ kṛtamūrdhajām śiraḥsthāne kṛtau pādau jahāsa ca mumoda ca
english: Seeing her impure — her hair on the feet's side, her feet placed where the head should be — Śakra laughed and was delighted.

sanskrit: tasyāḥ śarīravivaraṃ viveśa ca puraṃdaraḥ garbhaṃ ca saptadhā rāma bibheda paramātmavān
english: Purandara entered an opening of her body, O Rāma, and the supremely self-controlled one split the embryo into seven parts.

sanskrit: bidhyamānas tato garbho vajreṇa śataparvaṇā ruroda susvaraṃ rāma tato ditir abudhyata
english: As the embryo was thus being pierced by the hundred-jointed thunderbolt, it wept with a clear voice, O Rāma; thereupon Diti awoke.

sanskrit: mā rudo mā rudaś ceti garbhaṃ śakro 'bhyabhāṣata bibheda ca mahātejā rudantam api vāsavaḥ
english: "Do not weep, do not weep" — thus Śakra addressed the embryo; yet the greatly resplendent Vāsava continued to split it even as it wept.

sanskrit: na hantavyo na hantavya ity evaṃ ditir abravīt niṣpapāta tataḥ śakro mātur vacanagauravāt
english: "It must not be slain, it must not be slain" — thus Diti cried out; thereupon Śakra emerged out of respect for his mother's words.

sanskrit: prāñjalir vajrasahito ditiṃ śakro 'bhyabhāṣata aśucir devi suptāsi pādayoḥ kṛtamūrdhajā
english: With joined palms and thunderbolt in hand, Śakra addressed Diti: "O goddess, you slept in an impure posture — your hair on the side of the feet, your feet placed where the head should be."

sanskrit: tadantaram ahaṃ labdhvā śakrahantāram āhave abhindaṃ saptadhā devi tan me tvaṃ kṣantum arhasi
english: "Seizing that opportunity, I split into seven parts the one who would have been Śakra's slayer in battle, O goddess; you must forgive me for this."
